race.comment: SHRADDHA (13) is a filly by Ole Kirk out of Spicy on debut for the Michael Freedman stable. Looks a natural after leading throughout in good style over 850m at Randwick Kensington. Will park up on the speed and take catching. ENFIELD (3) is a filly on debut by Snitzel out of L'cosmo from the John Thompson yard. Finished second to SHRADDHA in a 850m trial. Lugging bit goes on and sure to be thereabouts. PROVATA (8) is a filly by Pierata out of Provide on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton yard. Strong through the line when third in her trial to SHRADDHA. Lugging bit goes on from the low draw. Makes plenty of appeal. SHE'S SUPREME (11) Marc & Mitchell Conners trained filly by Exceedance from a Pierro mare on debut. Tough trial winner and keep safe from the rails draw. OUTBACK AFFAIR (7) Home Affairs filly out of De Grawin on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott stable. Finished second in a trial at Randwick Kensington over 850m. Sure to be about the money.
